name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Sales Operations Coordinator | CRM Data Management, Pipeline Reporting & Cross-Team Coordination

Owns CRM systems end to end across HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, and Accelo's own CRM/PSA platform, catches and resolves data inconsistencies before they become sales problems, and works independently in fast-moving, remote B2B SaaS environments.

Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project and process records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Architected a complete marketing-automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, tagging, and routing, lead qualification, and appointment booking with confirmation and reminders.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20, later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and coordinated with the implementation team on delivery.
